description: A gray power strip sits on the green sheet in front of you, with a black power brick off to the left and a dark pillow at the back. The left hand reaches forward to steady the power strip as the right hand moves in, grips the black plug at the strip, and pulls it upward and away, making the plug a right-hand object while the strip remains a left-hand object; the right hand then sets the unplugged cord down on the strip and both hands withdraw.
